notes.subject: בפרע פרעות
notes.rationale: tok i gat planti minin: 'ol lida i lusim harim bilong het' (JPS) o 'ol lida i go stret pastaim' (ASV, פרע to begin) o 'ol i rausim ol man long raus'

notes.subject: bariku
notes.rationale: ברכו i minin 'blessim/kneel'; Tok Pisin i no gat tok stret, bariku i klostu

translation: Long taim ol lida i lusim ol harim bilong het long Yisrael, long taim ol manmeri bilong graun i givim yet long wok, ol i tingim gutpela tok bilong Yahwe — bariku long Yahwe.

tokens.gloss: long taim ol i givim yet long wok
